# MatchGraph { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph(
    claims=None,
    *,
    units=None,
    axis=None,
    source=None,
    source_id=None,
)
```

A graph of MatchClaims connecting events across timelines/groups.

The MatchGraph builds a networkx graph where:
- Nodes: (timeline_id, coordinate) tuples
- Edges: synchronous AlignmentAnchors (explicit or implicit)

Only synchronous claims produce graph edges. Non-synchronous claims
(conceptual matches, NOMATCH) are stored in ``_claims`` but do not
create nodes or edges.

Each Hendrix M-box (M1–M15) is a separate MatchGraph. The system
is NOT a global graph; MatchGraphs are created on demand.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type                                                                      | Description                                                              |
|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| claims | [list](`list`)\[[MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)\] | List of all MatchClaims in this graph (synchronous and non-synchronous). |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> # Build graph from claims
>>> graph = MatchGraph(claims=[claim1, claim2])
```

```python
>>> # Extend via group membership
>>> extended = graph.extend_to_groups(groups)
```

```python
>>> # Get synchronized timestamps
>>> stamps = graph.get_stamps()
```

### extend_to_groups { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph.extend_to_groups }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph.extend_to_groups(
    groups,
    *,
    include_inferred=True,
    timeline_ids=None,
    id_pattern=None,
    include_domains=None,
    include_units=None,
)
```

Extend anchors to full group timestamps via implicit claims.

For each coordinate in the graph, computes the equivalent coordinate
for every other member of every group its timeline belongs to and
adds an implicit ``MatchClaim`` (case d) plus the corresponding edge.
Membership is read from *groups* alone, and a timeline may belong to
several. A coordinate reached this way is extended in turn through
the other groups of its timeline, so a timeline shared by two groups
carries a coordinate from the members of one to the members of the
other. Filters control which timelines receive implicit claims; a
timeline they exclude receives no coordinate, so no extension passes
through it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                                  | Description                                | Default    |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| groups           | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), \'TimelineGroup\'\]                     | Dict of group_id -> TimelineGroup.         | _required_ |
| include_inferred | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Whether to add inferred edges.             | `True`     |
| timeline_ids     | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                  | Only extend to these timeline IDs.         | `None`     |
| id_pattern       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Regex filter for timeline IDs.             | `None`     |
| include_domains  | [set](`set`)\[[Domain](`timetoalign.core.enums.Domain`)\] \| None     | Only extend to timelines in these domains. | `None`     |
| include_units    | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None | Only extend to timelines with these units. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                                    |
|--------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchGraph\' | New MatchGraph with extended edges (or self if not extending). |

|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------|-----------|
| synchronous_only | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Include only synchronous edges.            | `False`   |

| include_units    | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None | Only include timelines with these units.   | `None`    |

### get_matchstamp { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph.get_matchstamp }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph.get_matchstamp()
```

Get the single MatchStamp for this graph.

One MatchGraph = one MatchStamp. The MatchStamp is the union of
all coordinates reachable through the graph's edges.

If the graph contains multiple disconnected components, this
method raises ``ValueError`` -- each component should be its own
MatchGraph. Use ``split_components()`` to separate them first, or
use the multi-component ``get_stamps()`` method.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                            |
|--------|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | \'MatchStamp\' | Single MatchStamp spanning all timelines in the graph. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the graph has multiple disconnected components. |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If the graph has no synchronous claims (no nodes). |

#### See Also {.doc-section .doc-section-see-also}

`split_components`: Split a multi-component graph into separate
    MatchGraph objects.
`get_stamps`: Multi-component method returning one stamp per component.

### get_stamps { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph.get_stamps }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph.get_stamps()
```

Get all MatchStamps from the graph.

Returns one MatchStamp per connected component, each containing
all coordinates reachable from that component.

Returns:
    List of MatchStamps, one per connected component.

### split_components { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph.split_components }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph.split_components()
```

Split this graph into one MatchGraph per connected component.

Each returned MatchGraph represents a single connected component
and can be queried with ``get_matchstamp()``.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                             | Description                                              |
|--------|----------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [list](`list`)\[\'MatchGraph\'\] | List of MatchGraph objects, one per connected component. |
|        | [list](`list`)\[\'MatchGraph\'\] | Empty list if the graph has no synchronous claims.       |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.alignment.MatchGraph.to_dict }

```python
alignment.MatchGraph.to_dict()
```

Serialize to dictionary.

Note: This serializes the claims, not the full graph.
The graph can be rebuilt from claims.
